add_rc_deps(rsrc.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/icon_3dtext.ico)

# 3dtext.scr is all Rust (text3d-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/text3d-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# 3dtext.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/text3d-rust/src/text3d/3dtext.rs)
# settings.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/text3d-rust/src/text3d/settings.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(3dtext_res OBJECT rsrc.rc)
target_compile_definitions(3dtext_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(3dtext_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(3dtext text3d-cargo 3dtext.scr
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE text3d-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS 3dtext_res psdk)
